name: Colors
source:
In the mountainous area of the town of Hoshino stars are shining way brighter than in Tokyo.
In such town Yuki loses parents in an accident and starts to lives with the relatives. At first she believes that she is only a nuisance, but with time she becomes a part of this new Izumi family.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
星野町山区的星星比东京还要明亮。
在这样的小镇里，由希在一场事故中失去了父母，开始与亲戚一起生活。起初她认为自己只是一个麻烦，但随着时间的推移，她成为了这个新的泉家庭的一员。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
